sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("user_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "config" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "finished_at" TEXT NULL, "score" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "answers" ("user_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id), "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "question_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "chosen" TEXT NULL, "is_correct" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_correct" IN (0, 1)), "time_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "answered_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER answers_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON answers BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'answers es de solo inserción');END
CREATE TRIGGER answers_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON answers BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'answers es de solo inserción');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "review_state" ("user_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "question_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "box" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("box" BETWEEN 0 AND 4), "correct_streak" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_due" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "pack_id", "question_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("user_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "key"));
CREATE INDEX answers_by_question ON answers (pack_id, question_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "packs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "language" TEXT NOT NULL, "author" TEXT NULL, "updated_on" TEXT NULL, "format_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "exam_note" TEXT NULL, "installed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "blocks" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES packs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pack_id", "id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "topics" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES packs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "block_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pack_id", "id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sources" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES packs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_official" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_official" IN (0, 1)), "date" TEXT NULL, "call" TEXT NULL, "shift" TEXT NULL, "answers_origin" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pack_id", "id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source_exercises" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES packs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "option_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "exam_exercise_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pack_id", "source_id", "id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "contexts" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES packs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "statement" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NULL, "language" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pack_id", "id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "questions" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES packs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_id" TEXT NULL, "number" TEXT NULL, "topic_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "context_id" TEXT NULL, "statement" TEXT NOT NULL, "options" TEXT NOT NULL, "correct_key" TEXT NULL, "is_reserve" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_reserve" IN (0, 1)), "voided" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("voided" IN (0, 1)), "provisional_key" TEXT NULL, "obsolete" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("obsolete" IN (0, 1)), "explanation" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "tags" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pack_id", "id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notes" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES packs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "topic_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_official" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_official" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("pack_id", "id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exam_exercises" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES packs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "question_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reserve_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "option_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_min" INTEGER NULL, "has_case_studies" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("has_case_studies" IN (0, 1)), "scoring" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pack_id", "id"));
CREATE INDEX questions_by_topic ON questions (pack_id, topic_id)
CREATE INDEX questions_by_source ON questions (pack_id, source_id)
